|game_text='''0 side — Imperial Occupation'''

Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker){{!}}Ice Plains]], and [Virtual Block 8] [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V) (Virtual Block 6){{!}}Main Power Generators]]. May deploy [[Imperial Decree]]. For remainder of game, AT-ATs deploy -1 to marker sites. [[Walker Garrison]] may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. Non-[Virtual Block 8] [[You May Start Your Landing (V){{!}}You May Start Your Landing]] is canceled. While this side up, [[Revolution]] is canceled. Once during your turn, may ▲ one [[AT-AT Cannon]], [[Hoth Blockade]], [[Electro-Rangefinder]], or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away' and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.

'''7 side — Imperial Control'''

While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may retrieve any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) into hand. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a marker site. Flip this card if Hoth Blockade not on Hoth.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]; it is the current text. Other versions: [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]] (original) and [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). No published image shows the 0 side of this text, so the first image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-72E-Imperial_Occupation-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026, before the PC-E1 errata of 21 September 2012 was found, hence its file name); the second is the Players Committee card image of the 7 side ([[:File:VB2-D-imperialcontrol-pre.gif]]), which shows this text, as do the Master List slips. The release-sheet slips show the original text (see [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slips 72E: 0 side “Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] Ice Plains, and Main Power Generators (Light Side). May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, Walker Garrison is an Out Of Play Interrupt and [Immune to Sense]. AT-ATs are deploy -1 to marker sites. While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force to your [Special Edition] Effects. During your control phase, may ▲ one AT-AT Cannon, Hoth Blockade, Electro-Rangefinder, or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away' and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.” 7 side “While this side up, Revolution is canceled. At marker sites, AT-ATs move for free. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may retrieve any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) into hand. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a marker site. Flip this card if Hoth Blockade not on Hoth.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 6, slip 72E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]]): a Competitive Balance Team errata, posted by the Players Committee in its “Current Rulings/Errata” forum thread on 21 September 2012, effective immediately<ref name="pcforum-p754463">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 21 September 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p754463 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>, rewrote the 0 side ([Virtual Block 8] Main Power Generators, Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing canceled, “Once during your turn”, no Force-loss limit; Walker Garrison still an Out Of Play Interrupt) and dropped “At marker sites, AT-ATs move for free.” from the 7 side. The E-marked Players Committee card images of the two sides ([[:File:VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif]], [[:File:VB2-D-imperialcontrol-pre.gif]]) print this text: 0 side “Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] Ice Plains, and [Virtual Block 8] Main Power Generators. May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, Walker Garrison is an Out Of Play Interrupt and [Immune to Sense]. AT-ATs are deploy -1 to marker sites. Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing is canceled. While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Once during your turn, may ▲ one AT-AT Cannon, Hoth Blockade, Electro-Rangefinder, or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators ‘blown away’ and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.” 7 side “While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may retrieve any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) into hand. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a marker site. Flip this card if Hoth Blockade not on Hoth.” The forum post types the 0 side with small differences (“Ice Plains and” without the comma, “Out of Play”, “Non-[Virtual]” for the [Virtual Block 8] icon, and no “one” before “AT-AT Cannon”); the text here is the card image's. Until 9 November 2026 this front text was held as an undated “third wording” of the card image; the forum post dates it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): a second errata, posted in the same forum thread on 19 November 2012 (“obsoletes all previous errata to this card”), the day the Players Committee removed the Out Of Play Interrupt subtype from the game<ref name="pcforum-p768283">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 November 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p768283 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>, changed the 0 side again (Walker Garrison “may only be played once per game”; “AT-ATs deploy -1 to marker sites”); the 7 side stayed as in PC-E1. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, slips marked E) prints this text: 0 side “Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] Ice Plains, and [Virtual Block 8] Main Power Generators. May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, AT-ATs deploy -1 to marker sites. Walker Garrison may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing is canceled. While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Once during your turn, may ▲ one AT-AT Cannon, Hoth Blockade, Electro-Rangefinder, or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away' and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.” 7 side “While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may retrieve any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) into hand. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a marker site. Flip this card if Hoth Blockade not on Hoth.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=50, page 50. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=50 Internet Archive]</ref>
